functions.name: bswap64
functions.signature: inline unsigned long long bswap64(unsigned long long x)
functions.description: Byte-swap a 64-bit unsigned integer value, reversing the order of its bytes. Useful for converting between little-endian and big-endian representations.
requirements: Argument x may be any 64-bit unsigned value; all bit patterns are accepted.
Function is pure and has no side effects.

functions.name: bswap32
functions.signature: inline unsigned int bswap32(unsigned int x)
functions.description: Byte-swap a 32-bit unsigned integer value, reversing the order of its bytes. Useful for endianness conversion.
requirements: Argument x may be any 32-bit unsigned value; all bit patterns are accepted.
Function is pure and has no side effects.

functions.name: bswap16
functions.signature: inline unsigned short bswap16(unsigned short x)
functions.description: Byte-swap a 16-bit unsigned integer value, reversing the order of its bytes.
requirements: Argument x may be any 16-bit unsigned value; all bit patterns are accepted.
Function is pure and has no side effects.

functions.name: bswapf
functions.description: Byte-swap a 32-bit float’s underlying bytes and reinterpret as float. This converts between float representations with opposite byte order.
requirements: Accepts any 32-bit float bit pattern; NaNs, infinities, and signaling values are preserved as their byte-swapped bit patterns.
Result is the reinterpretation of swapped bytes; not a numeric conversion.
Function is pure and has no side effects.

functions.name: bswapd
functions.description: Byte-swap a 64-bit double’s underlying bytes and reinterpret as double. This converts between double representations with opposite byte order.
requirements: Accepts any 64-bit double bit pattern; NaNs, infinities, and signaling values are preserved as their byte-swapped bit patterns.
Result is the reinterpretation of swapped bytes; not a numeric conversion.
Function is pure and has no side effects.

functions.name: operator+
functions.signature: swap_struct_t<T, F>::swapped_t operator+(const swap_struct_t<T, F>::swapped_t &i) const
functions.description: Member addition. Adds two swapped-endian wrapper values by converting both to host order, adding, and storing the result back in swapped form.
requirements: Defined for swap_struct_t<T, F>.
Underlying type T must support operator+(T,T).

functions.name: operator-
functions.signature: swap_struct_t<T, F>::swapped_t operator-(const swap_struct_t<T, F>::swapped_t &i) const
functions.description: Member subtraction. Subtracts another swapped-endian value from this one in host order and returns the result in swapped form.
requirements: Defined for swap_struct_t<T, F>.
Underlying type T must support operator-(T,T).

functions.name: operator/
functions.signature: swap_struct_t<T, F>::swapped_t operator/(const swap_struct_t<T, F>::swapped_t &i) const
functions.description: Member division. Divides this value by another swapped-endian value in host order and returns the result in swapped form.
requirements: Underlying type T must support operator/(T,T).
If T is an integral type, divisor i must not be zero.

functions.name: operator*
functions.signature: swap_struct_t<T, F>::swapped_t operator*(const swap_struct_t<T, F>::swapped_t &i) const
functions.description: Member multiplication. Multiplies two swapped-endian values in host order and returns the result in swapped form.
requirements: Underlying type T must support operator*(T,T).

functions.name: operator%
functions.signature: template <typename S, typename T, typename F> S operator%(const S &i, const swap_struct_t<T, F> &v)
functions.description: Free-function modulus allowing S % swap_struct_t. Converts v to host order and computes i % v.swap(), returning S.
requirements: Type S must support operator%(S,T); typically both S and T are integral types.
The right-hand operand v.swap() must not be zero for integral types.

functions.name: operator+=
functions.description: Member compound addition assignment. Adds another swapped-endian value to this in host order and stores the result back (in swapped form).
requirements: Underlying type T must support operator+(T,T).

functions.name: operator-=
functions.description: Member compound subtraction assignment. Subtracts another swapped-endian value from this in host order and stores the result back (in swapped form).
requirements: Underlying type T must support operator-(T,T).

functions.name: operator&
functions.signature: swap_struct_t<T, F>::swapped_t operator&(const swap_struct_t<T, F>::swapped_t &b) const
functions.description: Member bitwise AND. ANDs two swapped-endian values in host order and returns the result in swapped form.
requirements: Underlying type T must support bitwise operator&(T,T).

functions.name: operator<
functions.description: Member less-than comparison between swapped-endian values. Compares in host order.
requirements: Underlying type T must support operator<(T,T).

functions.name: operator>
functions.description: Member greater-than comparison between swapped-endian values. Compares in host order.
requirements: Underlying type T must support operator>(T,T).

functions.name: operator<=
functions.description: Member less-than-or-equal comparison between swapped-endian values. Compares in host order.
requirements: Underlying type T must support operator<=(T,T).

functions.name: operator>=
functions.description: Member greater-than-or-equal comparison between swapped-endian values. Compares in host order.
requirements: Underlying type T must support operator>=(T,T).

functions.name: operator!=
functions.description: Member inequality comparison between swapped-endian values. Compares in host order.
requirements: Underlying type T must support operator!=(T,T).

functions.name: operator==
functions.description: Member equality comparison between swapped-endian values. Compares in host order.
requirements: Underlying type T must support operator==(T,T).
